entries.name: Oracle HRMS
entries.definition: The human-resources applications of Oracle E-Business Suite, covering employee records, payroll, benefits, time and training.

entries.name: Oracle OLAP
entries.definition: An option of Oracle Database that stores multidimensional data in analytic workspaces and answers online analytical processing queries.

entries.name: Oracle Primavera
entries.definition: Oracle's family of project portfolio management software, best known for Primavera P6, used to plan and schedule large projects.

entries.name: Oracle Reports
entries.definition: An Oracle tool for designing and running formatted, paginated reports from the data in Oracle Database.

entries.name: Oracle Workflow
entries.definition: An Oracle tool, used with Oracle Database and E-Business Suite, for modelling and automating business processes as workflows.

entries.name: Oral cancer screening
entries.definition: Examining the mouth, lips, tongue and throat for early signs of cancer or precancerous lesions.

entries.name: Oral hygiene
entries.definition: The practices that keep the mouth, teeth and gums clean and healthy, such as brushing, flossing and cleaning dentures.

entries.name: Order of draw
entries.definition: The recommended sequence for filling blood-collection tubes during venipuncture so that additives from one tube do not contaminate the next.

entries.name: Organic composition of capital
entries.definition: In Marxian economics, the ratio of the capital spent on machinery and materials to the capital spent on wages.

entries.name: Organization development
entries.definition: The field and practice of planned, behavioural-science-based efforts to improve how an organisation works and how its people work together.

entries.name: Organizational change
entries.definition: How and why an organisation alters its strategy, structure, processes or culture, and how that change is planned and managed.

entries.name: Organizational culture change
entries.definition: Deliberately shifting the shared values, norms and habits of an organisation so that people work differently.

entries.name: Organizational leadership
entries.definition: Guiding people and setting direction across an organisation so that it meets its goals.

entries.name: OrientDB
entries.definition: An open-source NoSQL database, written in Java, that combines graph, document, key-value and object models.

entries.name: Orthopaedic nursing
entries.definition: Caring for patients with bone, joint and muscle conditions, injuries and surgery.

entries.name: OpenTelemetry
entries.definition: Instrumentation tooling; related to observability, not a synonym.

entries.name: Outbound logistics
entries.definition: The part of logistics that moves finished goods from a business to its customers, including order fulfilment, warehousing, transport and delivery.

entries.name: Outpatient surgery
entries.definition: Surgery after which the patient goes home the same day, without an overnight stay in hospital.

entries.name: OutSystems
entries.definition: A low-code platform for building, deploying and managing web and mobile applications.

entries.name: Over-the-road driving
entries.definition: Driving a truck over long distances between cities and states, usually spending nights away from home.

entries.name: Overhead camshaft engine
entries.definition: A piston engine whose camshaft sits in the cylinder head, above the valves, and operates them directly or through short rockers.

entries.name: Overhead cost analysis
entries.definition: Examining a business's indirect costs, such as rent, utilities and administration, and how they are allocated to products or departments.

entries.name: Overhead crane operation
entries.definition: Operating an overhead or bridge crane, which runs on rails above a work area, to lift and move loads.

entries.name: Overhead valve engine
entries.definition: A piston engine whose valves sit in the cylinder head and are operated by pushrods from a camshaft in the engine block.

entries.name: Oxidation processes
entries.definition: Chemical processes in which a substance loses electrons or combines with oxygen, such as those used in water treatment, metal finishing and chemical manufacturing.

entries.name: package.json
entries.definition: The manifest file of a Node.js project, written in JSON, that records the project's name, version, dependencies and scripts.

entries.name: Packaging machine operation
entries.definition: Setting up, running and monitoring machines that fill, seal, wrap or label products for packaging.

entries.name: Padrino
entries.definition: A Ruby web framework built on top of Sinatra that adds helpers, generators and a modular structure.

entries.name: Page layout
entries.definition: Arranging text, images and other elements on a page or screen so that it is clear and visually balanced.

entries.name: Pallet building
entries.definition: Stacking and securing goods on a pallet so that they can be stored or shipped.

entries.name: Palm OS
entries.definition: An operating system for handheld computers (PDAs) and early smartphones, developed by Palm.

entries.name: pandas
entries.definition: A Python library for data analysis that provides DataFrame and Series structures for loading, cleaning, transforming and summarising tabular data.

entries.name: Pandemic preparedness
entries.definition: The planning and measures that prepare a health system, workplace or community to respond to a pandemic.

entries.name: Paperwork Reduction Act
entries.definition: A US federal law that requires agencies to minimise the paperwork burden on the public and to get approval from the Office of Management and Budget before collecting information.

entries.name: Parallel computing
entries.definition: Dividing computation into work performed concurrently.

entries.name: Parasympathetic nervous system
entries.definition: The part of the autonomic nervous system that slows the heart and promotes rest-and-digest functions such as digestion.

entries.name: PARI/GP
entries.definition: A computer algebra system for fast computations in number theory, with its own scripting language called GP.

entries.name: Paris Agreement
entries.definition: The 2015 international climate treaty in which countries agreed to hold global warming well below 2 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels and to pursue 1.5 degrees.

entries.name: Parrot AR.Drone
entries.definition: A quadcopter drone made by Parrot that is flown from a smartphone or tablet.

entries.name: Partnership taxation
entries.definition: The tax rules for partnerships, under which income and losses pass through to the partners, covered in the US by Subchapter K of the Internal Revenue Code.
